name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fix: Plex-sourced content's media quality (bitrate) was never reported to Jellyfin at all, which is what made its own client-side quality selector fall back to a low, generic default regardless of the source's actual quality - looking like every Plex item was capped around 1Mbps no matter how good the real file was. Plex reports one combined bitrate per Media entry, in kbps, that ApplyMediaDetails simply never read; it's now attributed to the video stream (converted to bps), the same approximation used elsewhere when a precise per-stream split isn't available. A backfill pass fixes already-synced Plex items with this fix too, not just future syncs. 267 tests, all green.
